request.description: Create a new product with images. Requires ADMIN role. Images are uploaded as files (up to 6 images). First image will be set as primary. Key points should be provided as a JSON array string.

response.name: Success Response

formdata.description: New product images (optional, up to 6 images)

request.description: Update product details. Requires ADMIN role. All fields are optional. Images can be added (up to 6 images).
Delete a product. Requires ADMIN role.
Get all visible product categories
Create a new product category with cover image. Requires ADMIN role.
Update product category. Requires ADMIN role. All fields are optional.
Delete (soft delete) a product category by setting visibility to false. Requires ADMIN role.
Get all reviews for a specific product
Create a review for a product. Requires authentication (ADMIN or CUSTOMER role). Rating must be between 1-5. Each user can only review a product once.
Get all reviews with pagination and filtering. Requires authentication (ADMIN or CUSTOMER role).

request.description: Update inquiry status. Status can be PENDING, RESPONDED, or CONVERTED.
Send quotation email to the inquiry sender. Requires authentication (ADMIN or CUSTOMER role). Subject and message are required.
Delete an inquiry. Requires authentication (ADMIN role).
Add a product to cart. Requires authentication (CUSTOMER or ADMIN role).
Get current user's cart. Requires authentication (CUSTOMER or ADMIN role).
Update cart item quantity. Requires authentication (CUSTOMER role).
Remove item from cart. Requires authentication (CUSTOMER role).
Create order from cart and initiate payment. Requires authentication (CUSTOMER or ADMIN role).
Get current user's orders. Requires authentication (CUSTOMER role).
Get order details by ID. Requires authentication (CUSTOMER role).
Cancel an order. Requires authentication (CUSTOMER role).
Get all orders. Admin only.
Get order details by ID. Admin only.
Update order status. Admin only.
Create or update shipping rate. Requires authentication (ADMIN or CUSTOMER role).
Get all shipping rates
Toggle shipping rate active status
Get current user's payment history. Requires authentication (CUSTOMER role).
Get payment details for a specific order. Requires authentication (CUSTOMER role).
Retry payment for a failed order. Requires authentication (CUSTOMER role).
SSLCOMMERZ payment success callback (no authentication required)
SSLCOMMERZ payment fail callback (no authentication required)
SSLCOMMERZ payment cancel callback (no authentication required)
SSLCOMMERZ Instant Payment Notification (IPN) callback (no authentication required)
Get payments summary/statistics. Requires authentication (ADMIN or CUSTOMER role).
Get all payments with pagination and filtering. Requires authentication (ADMIN or CUSTOMER role).
Get payment details by ID. Requires authentication (ADMIN or CUSTOMER role).
Get payment audit trail. Requires authentication (ADMIN or CUSTOMER role).
Get all payments for a specific order. Requires authentication (ADMIN or CUSTOMER role).
Mark payment as failed. Requires authentication (ADMIN or CUSTOMER role).
Mark payment as paid. Requires authentication (ADMIN or CUSTOMER role).
